description: Josh Umbaugh grew up in a small Midwestern town, the kind with one stoplight and cornfields stretching in every direction. Those early years taught him the value of hard work, honesty, and looking out for your neighbors. It was a close-knit community where people helped each other, and that spirit of connection has guided Josh […]
